subject: info-ds
title: (R)INFO.DS.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in WI-29. (R)INFO-DS — the reality of information dissemination — is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance). INFO-DS → C-CONT (the crossing). RE-ST (restructuralism) branches from the main line. A second line from the main line runs to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications); PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) branches from it, and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) branches from PHY-U-P. COS-P (cosmic particulars) also branches from the T-C-IMP line; HI-P (high purpose) branches from COS-P, and both TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics) and TRS (transition) branch from HI-P.
